name: Doro Comfort 3000 Desk Corded
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk. Photo to be confirmed.
description: The Doro Comfort 3000 is a big-button corded desk phone with amplified sound (up to +30 dB) for the hard of hearing, three photo direct-memory keys and a visual ring indicator. Hearing-aid compatible with adjustable tone and volume.
